journey.title: Capture an existing routine
journey.purpose: Turn rough pasted text or a sequence of meal names into a review queue of detected meals, slots, foods, and supplements without inventing quantities, brands, or doses.

steps.intent: Paste or name the meals and supplements I already take without entering nutrition.
Review the detected items and answer only the material quantity and duplicate questions.
Accept recurring baseline slots and express the supplements as a fixed schedule.
Correct an inverted target bound before saving the routine.

claims.statement: Rough text becomes a review queue, and the system preserves the source text without inventing amounts, brands, or doses.
Accepted recurring slots become baseline templates while the flexible slots remain open to later variation.
